title: Battle for Olympus
description:
Born without divine powers, Leon endures relentless torment at the Demigod Academy. Orion, son of the Thunder God, forces Leon’s childhood sweetheart, Selina, into a marriage pact before casting him into Tartarus, the abyss where ancient forbidden beings are imprisoned. On the brink of death, Leon’s thirst for vengeance awakens the Titan King. Granted the power of destruction, he undergoes grueling training in the abyss and emerges transformed.

Months later, Leon storms the engagement banquet astride a beast from hell, slays Orion, and rescues Selina before she can sacrifice herself to take her captor down. Fleeing together, Selina unleashes her sealed moon goddess powers, and the two fight off their Olympian pursuers. When Zeus himself descends to lay waste to a city with divine wrath, Selina sacrifices her soul to protect Leon, helping him achieve his ultimate Titan transformation.

Consumed by grief, Leon carries her ice coffin into Olympus alone. His Titan bloodline merges with the remnants of Selina’s divinity, resurrecting her as a goddess. Together, they wage a fierce battle, slay Zeus, and overthrow the old gods. Above the shattered divine throne, they embrace the dawn of a new world.

description: Violet gave seventeen of her life to her fated mate — Kaden Cross. She grew up by his side, devoting everything to him. Humiliated, devastated, betrayed, Violet opens her eyes and makes a choice. She breaks their mate bond and leave this monstrous place behind. But right as Violet's about to break free and start again— the man that cast her out is the one on his knees, begging for her to come back.

title: Learn Numbers for Kids
description:
Learn numbers easy and fast for kids
Is it time for your kid to learn numbers? Is your child finding it hard to work with numbers? Don’t worry we for the best ideas for you that will make it easy for your kid to learn numbers easily and very quickly. 
Numbers will form the basic foundation for your kid's learning process. These are the first steps towards academic learning and this foundation needs to be very strong if you want your kid to grasp the upcoming concepts quickly and very firmly. 
So how can you learn numbers easily and fast? Let’s talk in detail.
1. Casually repeat the numbers at home
The more the child hears it the more he/she will learn quickly. Make it a habit to sing or repeat the numbers casually around the house. Gradually the kid will start to grasp the tune and will start repeating the numbers. So, in this way, the numbers will become a part of his/her memory without much effort. 
2. Use some books
You can use the kid's book to make your kid familiar with the numbers. How they look, and how they are pronounced. Kids get very attracted to colors and cartoons so choose a book that they like and enjoy. The more they enjoy reading the book, the quicker they will learn. 
3. Use toys 
There are many numbers of toys available, like blocks. They are very helpful for the kids in fast learning. The kid will learn while he is playing, and this is by far the best method to teach the kids. 
4. Use videos
There are many YouTube videos that teach the kids numbers. They are made for toddlers and are very attractive to the kids. Watching them repeatedly will help the kids learn the numbers easily and fast. So, use some good YouTube videos. 
You can adopt any of the ways that your child responds the best too. Give your child the time to learn and you will see a very good result.

title: Guitar for Beginners
description:
Grasp the essentials needed to begin playing acoustic or electric guitar. You'll learn an easy approach to get you playing quickly, through a combination of exploring the instrument, performance technique, and basic music theory.
For students who have long thought about picking up the acoustic or electric guitar, this course will provide an easy-access foundation that will get you playing. When first learning guitar, it is important to have the material presented in stages, in an enjoyable way that allows you to grasp the basics of the instrument and music. The course begins simply with the parts of the guitar, the names of the strings, tuning, and technique—whether finger-style or pick. It then explores the basics of music theory with such topics as scales, triads, power chords, and fingering and shapes.
At the end of this course, students will understand the structure, parts, and accessories of the instrument, in addition to an understanding of its basic maintenance. Electric guitar players will learn the operation of their instrument along with basic options for amplification, effect pedals, and sounds. Students will also learn to develop correct technique and apply theory concepts to their playing. They will have the foundational knowledge necessary to pursue most intermediate guitar courses.

title: C for Everyone, Part 1: Programming Fundamentals
description:
This course is for everyone. In the new world we live in, coding is a universally valuable skill, whether you're a scientist, artist, or a humanist. Algorithms are everywhere, and we all have to understand how they work. The C language is particularly well suited as an introduction to coding: It's a tried-and-true language, and it allows you to understand computing processes at a deep level. 
This course is the first part of a two-course sequence. It is a hands-on introduction to programming in C, designed to guide learners step by step from the basics of syntax and data types to more advanced concepts such as control flow, functions, recursion, arrays, and pointers. Through video lessons, quizzes, programming exercises, and real debugging tasks, learners build foundational concepts and good coding practices. By the end, learners will be able to write clear C programs, debug effectively, and build the knowledge base needed for more advanced computer science and software development.

title: Ascendance of a Bookworm [English]
description: Urano, a young Japanese soon-to-be librarian, dies in an earthquake. She is reincarnated in another world as a young girl named Mayne, but learns that books are scarce and only provided to prestigious elites. Mayne (retaining her memories from her previous life) decides to create and print her own books so that she can read again.

title: Gamers! [English]
description: This is a story that revolves around certain students and one hobby. Amano Keita is our lonely protagonist who has a passion for gaming and is friends with Uehara Tasuku, who is secretly a fellow gamer and is someone who believes his life is perfect. We also have Karen Tendou, the club president of the video games club and Chiaki Hoshinomori, who constantly bickers with Keita. This is a story filled with a non-stop sequence of comedy scenes and misunderstandings. Our chaotic romantic comedy now begins.

title: A Bolsa Ou a Vida
description: In the post-pandemic future of covid-19, which alternative will be given more attention: the financial casino and the accumulation of wealth by an elite or quality life for all, with less inequality? Has the minimal state proved capable of serving the collective? How can life be guaranteed without social and labor rights? What model of society do we want to live in? The film addresses the dismantling of the concept of social welfare and makes us reflect on the incompatibility of neoliberalism with a humanist project for society.

title: A House on a Hill
description: Harry is an irascible, aging architect trying to achieve the dream of building his masterwork. A wealthy young couple has commissioned Harry to design and rebuild a house he once owned that had burned down. Though reluctant at first, he eventually takes on the assignment and develops a new sense of purpose when his ex-wife Mercedes gives him her blessing. Harry soon realizes that the work has tapped into the vigor and promise of his youth. In the meantime Gaby has been hired to make a documentary about Harry--her project helps to reveal a complex man who, because of personal tragedy, has never attained the greatness most people felt he was destined for.

title: A Wave, a WAC and a Marine
description: Henny, talent scout for the Margaret Ames Film Agency in Hollywood, mistakes understudies Judy and Marian for Eileen and Betty, the real stars of a Broadway show and signs them up for movies. Margaret, furious with Henny for the blunder, fires him--temporarily. Another agent, Marty Allen, once married to and still in love with Margaret, signs Betty and Eileen. Henny arrives with Judy and Marian, and the nightclub manager asks Henny to emcee the show. Though he is not sure himself what they can do, Henny introduces the girls and they make a hit in a dramatic sketch. (Simmer down, it's just a Monogram movie, and their nightclub attendees can react anyway director Phil Karlstein/Karlson wants them to.) Big-time movie producer R. J. signs them to a film contract. What does this have to do with the title, "A WAVE, a WAC and a Marine"? Judy joins the WAVES, Marian the WACS and Marty the Marines and all have two weeks before induction, and that is more than long enough to shoot a Monogram musical-within-a-Monogram musical and have a few days to spare.

description: Miles E Benedict is a socially awkward teenager living in the crumbling district of Thatcher Heights. title: I Wish I Was Like You
description: "I wish I Was Like You" is a documentary about the Nirvana concert that was held in Marino in the Province of Rome on February 22, 1994. But it is also a backwards journey through the '90s, conducted by the two directors, spectators of that era and that memorable event. The Palaghiaccio (Ice Palace) in Marino, where the concert was held, now stands abandoned, dilapidated and sadly destined to become a supermarket. 25 years after Nirvana's last public performances and Kurt Cobain's death, the structure appears as a symbol of decadence but also becomes the point of departure for a celebration of those protagonists and a reflection on that historical period. The general tone is semi-serious, ironic and sacrilegious: the two directors handle the subject of the memory in a light-hearted manner with the aid of personal archival material shot on VHS-C during the many wild nights they spent together when they were kids. The documentary is further enriched by a precious bootleg recording of the Nirvana concert, restored and remastered for the occasion. "I Wish I Was Like You" is a true declaration of love to the filmmakers' youth and its most precious soundtrack: Kurt Cobain and Nirvana.

title: Daily T
description:
Thomas J Elliott is a master filmmaker who has worked all over the world, creating multi award winning projects for some of the world's leading global brands, from Coca-Cola to Microsoft, Manulife, global advertising agencies and anywhere and everywhere in between.

Beyond his work in content and commercials, he has directed documentaries, television series and more recently he has branched off into feature films and streaming content.

He is the author of five award-winning, best-selling books on visual content and visual storytelling.

In addition to this he is a regular contributor to leading educational workshops and events all over the world, from massive events like VidCon to private workshops for universities, think tanks and global brands and agencies.

In this first of its kind series created exclusively for social media platform LinkedIn, Thomas shares his thoughts on crafting and creating films and visual content as well as a deep dive into the directing process that covers everything from selecting the right material, to working with actors and crew, on set process and getting your work completed and out there.

The series provides a unique insight into an established working director, his process, the reality of working with brands, agencies, production companies, actors and production partners.

It shows the audience real world examples they can use in their work immediately to improve the quality of their work and their output.

Episodes are released weekly Monday to Friday on LinkedIn and across other channels.

title: M
description: Satoko is a housewife who lives a comfortable life with her businessman husband Hideyuki and her six-year-old son Masato. One day on her way to pick up Masato, she meets Minoru - a newspaper delivery boy who happens to be playing catch with Masato. At first glance Minoru seems to be a serious, hard-working young man. But she learns that when he was twelve he stabbed and killed his father, who was beating up his mother. He had done this to protect his mother, but instead she abandoned her son and disappeared. Minoru sees a little of his mother in Satoko, and starts to follow her around. As he does, he discovers that Satoko is being threatened by the yakuza Tawara. Soon Satoko's husband Hideyuki senses something wrong as his wife begins to change, and comes up with some wild ideas. As passion and love envelop them, Minoru tries to save Satoko. Satoko wishes to escape, but fear keeps her from doing so. What each person feels... is it reality or just an illusion?

title: You're Fired
description: Railroad magnate Gordon Rogers agrees to allow his daughter, Helen, to marry wealthy idler Billy Deering, Jr., but only if the latter can hold the same job for one month. Billy is hired for an array of jobs, including office clerk and xylophone player, but always quits just before being fired. He then finds work in a restaurant where he is required to dress as a knight in armor and pose as a statue. On one occasion, Gordon, Helen, and Billy's romantic rival, Tom, enter the restaurant, and Billy is nearly fired when Helen recognizes him. Meanwhile, Gordon plans to merge one of his railroads with a company that is in a dispute with Tom's uncle, an unprincipled financier. Acting on the promise of a generous cash reward, Tom is determined to steal documents relating to the merger. Billy manages to stay at his job for thirty days, and in the process, exposes Tom's scheme, winning Gordon's consent to marry Helen.

title: Aika R-16: Virgin Mission
description: The Treasure Hunt Club celebrates a failed kidnapping attempt by throwing a bikini beach party.

title: We're Still Together
description: Chris can't get along with anyone. When he's attacked in the street Bobby, a manic single dad, jumps in. The two set out into the Montreal night together crashing parties, meeting girls, and eventually seeing Bobby's estranged daughter - Chris soon discovers that the underside to Bobby's charm is a self-destructive streak. Over the course of the night, as they come to know each other they try not to lose themselves.

title: Prescription R
description: Richard is on the run from Glasgow's criminal underworld, after the collapse of its drug manufacturing operation. When he turns to his friend for help things will take a dark turn for the worst, before descending into chaos.

title: C(r)ook
description: A killer for the Russian Mafia in Vienna wants to retire and write a book about his passion - cooking. The mafia godfather suspects treason.

title: 307-r
description: '307-r' treats about a mysterious soldier put in a post-apocalyptic scenery; he has no name and, unfortunately, he finds himself inside the humid torture room of the enemy, who will force him to face the demons of a tormented mind. The soldier lives in a so-called limbo of a future society where the one and the only law which is observed is "homo homini lupus"; he plays his personal chess game in a constant balance between the physical violence and the psychological torture, in a delirious climax whose highest point is an external act of becoming conscious of the situation. How long can a man resist under torture? How far can a man push his limits? But, above all, who is the mole?

title: Vostok n 20
description: Daily life in a third-class Transsiberian wagon named Vostok N 20. Between discomfort, shared meals, boredom and confessions to strangers, people spend their time as they can. In the form of literary counterpoint, poems of Marina Tsvétaeva told by Fanny Ardant illuminates the feelings of passengers: their loneliness, their desires for freedom and love.

title: Bldg. N
description: A college student, Shiori, visits an abandoned apartment complex in a provincial city, which is famous for its rumors of hauntings, out of curiosity along with Keita and Maho, who also attend the university. However, there are numerous residents there. As Shiori and her friends begin to investigate, they suddenly experience a violent "bizarre rap phenomenon" and a resident jumps to his death right in front of them.

title: Hill 'n' Gully
description: Ten year old Sara Sapphire attacks a kid who taunts her in class, gets suspended for a week and can only return to school if her mother takes her to a psychiatrist to deal with her explosive temper. Dr. Moses discovers that the angry root in Sara grows even deeper in her mother, Carin Shiquita and her grandmother who suffers from agoraphobia. During her week of suspension, Sara Sapphire goes to work with Carin. There, photographer Caleb Foster, who is painfully shy, frequents the restaurant in which Carin works hoping to take her picture and ask her out on a date...not just any date, but his first date ever!

title: Wild 'N Out S6-S21
description: Watch as Nick Cannon and a new A-list celebrity lead a team of improv comedians each week as they compete against each other in the new show: Nick Cannon Presents Wild 'N Out.

title: เมื่อดวงดาวส่งเขา\Nกลับมาอีกครั้ง
description: คุณหนูตาบอดหลินจืออี้กับหัวหน้าสายลับหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าว แต่งงานกันสายฟ้าแลบเพราะถูกครอบครัวเร่งเร้า คืนแรกที่จดทะเบียนสมรส หลินจืออี้ก็เผชิญหน้ากับคดีฆาตกรรมจนเกือบถูกฆ่าปิดปาก โชคดีที่ผู้รอดชีวิตอย่างเธอ สามารถแย่งชิงมรดกกลับมาจากพี่ชายต่างบิดาได้ โดยมีคนรักอย่างหลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวคอยช่วยเหลือ แต่ทว่า เนื่องจากอุบัติเหตุทางรถที่ถูกจัดฉาก ทำให้หลี่เจิ้งฮ่าวต้องตายเพราะปกป้องหลินจืออี้ และบริจาคกระจกตาให้เธอ ห้าปีต่อมา หลินจืออี้ที่กลับมามองเห็นได้อีกครั้ง กลับมาพร้อมลูกสาวเพื่อสอบสวนความจริงของอุบัติเหตุในตอนนั้น แต่กลับพบกับประธานหน้าหล่อแต่ใจร้ายอย่างหลี่เสวียนปิน การต่อสู้เพื่อฐานะและการต่อสู้ระหว่างตระกูลเศรษฐีจึงเริ่มขึ้น

title: Il mistero di Lovecraft - Road to L.
description: 1997: A student of folklore named Andrea Roberti hypothesizes the possible link between the horror literature of H.P. Lovecraft and the dark folk tales of the Po Delta, a mysterious and remote part of northern Italy. 2002: One of the directors of the film comes across a manuscript in Montecatini (Italy) which may have belonged to the American writer. This journal, dated 1926, describes travels in Italy through the Po Delta in search of inspiration in the form of local folk stories: the Filò Tales. 2004: A small, tough crew of international filmmakers is put together with the help of David, a New York actor, to make a documentary on the finding of the journal and on the links between Lovecraft and the Po Delta. If the manuscript really did belong to Lovecraft, it would be an extraordinary discovery. As soon as they begin, however, the filmmakers find that Andrea Roberti disappeared in mysterious circumstances many years before, his car found abandoned on the banks of the Po. The crew sets up its base in the town of Loreo - referred to simply as L. in the manuscript - as the author of the journal did. During their investigations the atmosphere of animosity and foreboding rises and they soon discover that strange and disturbing things have been happening in the area. Events that the locals are eager to keep secret. The film "Road to L." is the true account of what took place behind the scenes of the 11 day shoot, reporting how the failures and revelations experienced in L. came to resemble ever more a journey to... Hell. Did Lovecraft really come into contact with something sinister? Did Andrea Roberti stumble across something he wasn't meant to find? The documentary makers are stepping too far into the unknown...

title: My Boss
description: Founder of Jun Heng Law Firm, Qian Heng, and rookie lawyer, Cheng Yao, go from boss/employee to landlord/tenant in a shared house. They began to rub off on each other in terms of work, life, habits and principles and began to fall in love.

title: Plan C
description: A secret grassroots organization persistently fights to expand access to abortion pills across the USA keeping hope alive during a global pandemic and the fall of Roe v. Wade.

title: Studio C+
description: Join Lisa Clark Valentine as she interviews your favorite cast members, gives a peek behind the scenes, and looks back on fan favorite Studio C moments. Fans interact with the cast through activities like breaking out of an escape room.

title: Munnabhai S.S.C.
description: Munnbhai (Amit) has been repeating in SSC frequently.He is good at heart and sports but mischievous.Fed up with his daily tantrums his father throws him out of the house.

title: P-Chan Busting Into America
description: Eight scenes of a busty Japanese model's work in Philadelphia, including an interview, the "P-Chan Big Tit Workout," behind the scenes at a photo shoot and "The World's First Theremin Boob Concert."

title: Cinema Conversations with Stephen P. Jarchow
description: Join host Stephen P. Jarchow as he sits down for an up close and personal conversation with some of the most talented and accomplished individuals in the world of motion pictures today.

title: V.I.P
description: VIP show is a show to satisfies the desires of rich and powerful through pleasure in secret. Suddenly, a comic about the VIP show starts circulating that shows Alimaa having sex with everyone she meets. Alimaa searches for who is doing it.

title: Jhong, Vhong at Kim, nagpagalingan ng joke
description:
Kung may isang alamat na hindi nakakasawang balik-balikan, ito 'yung alamat na masarap panoorin habang sila'y kumakanta at nagsasayawan. None other than P-Pop group, ALAMAT, na nagbabalik ang grupo sa 'It's Showtime' studio para i-perform ang Luzviminda,

Walang basaan dito pero bubumuhos ang swerte at good vibes kasama ang mga taga-San Juan City (na kilala sa 'Wattah Wattah' Festival) sa 'Laro Laro Pick' game arena.

Naglaro rin sina Teddy Corpuz, Darren Espanto, Jackie Gonzaga at Ryan Bang. Si Jackie lang ang nakatawid sa 'You Gotta Lyric,' kung saan tama naman ang sagot niya, pero pabirong idineklarang "wrong" ni Jhong Hilario dahil sintunado. To the rescue naman si Darren para itama ang tono! Dackie moment na ‘to!

Samantala, na-touch ang Showtime hosts sa kuwento ng buhay ni Wo, isang delivery rider na laki sa lolo. Habang itinataguyod ang sariling pamilya, gusto rin niyang maibalik ang sakripisyo ng lolong nagpalaki sa kanya. Samantala, 'extra' ang banter nina Kim Chiu at Jhong na nauwi pa nga sa dilatan ng mga mata. At syempre, kanya-kanya silang entry ng jokes tungkol sa pangalan ni Wo!

Very good din si Tate, ang tricycle driver na sweet lover kay misis, at may malasakit din sa kapwa. Minsan na niyang pinatunayan ang kabutihan nang ibalik ang gamit na naiwan ng pasahero. Kaya ang madlang girls sa studio, na-in love kay Tate! 'Yun nga lang, si misis, umapela, "Sorry po, married na!"

Luck ay na-attract ni Margo, ang hairstylist na 'di nauubusan ng kuwento. Pati tungkol kina Ogie Alcasid at Anne Curtis, meron siyang 'chismis.' At shoutout sa mga ex niya, hanggang tingin na lang daw kayo sa kan'yang ganda! Umabot sa P35,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na tinanggap ni Margo. Tama ang pinili ate n'yo dahil nang subukan niya ang P350k Pot question, akala niya'y 'simple' lang pero hindi pala niya alam ang kasagutan.

It's time for Region 1 to shine sa second week ng ika-10 taon ng "Tawag Ng Tanghalan."

Ang unang kalahok ay mula Laoag City, si Jeanel Silvestre, na nagpamalas ng husay sa entablado, singing Juan Karlos ‘JK’ Labajo's "Demonyo." Katulad ng idol na si JK, nagsusulat din ng kanta si Jeanel, na bet 'piratahin' ni Ogie nang magustuhan ang sample ng self-composition nito. Speaking of songwriting, may tip si Ogie tungkol d'yan.

Ang awit daw ay hinuhugot sa sariling kuwento, parang si Louie Ocampo, na binuo ang "Tell Me" mula sa sariling karanasan. Binalikan din ng 'Showtime' family ang iba pang iconic songs na nilikha ng maestro. Proud din si Ogie dahil komposisyon ng kanyang kaibigan

ang napiling bagong theme song ng isang airline. Chika niya, isa siya sa napakaraming tinalo ni Sir Louie sa paggawa ng theme song na 'to.

Samantala, napabilib ni Jeanel sina hurado Jonathan Manalo, Bituin Escalante, at Maestro Louie. Para sa kanila, strength ni Jeanel ang pagiging chill nito, at ang magandang tone.

Mula Pangasinan, lumuwas si Shekinah Barbiran to chase her dream sa tanghalan. "Ikaw Ay Ako" ni Klarisse De Guzman ang napili niyang sandata sa laban ng bosesan. At 15, 'beterano' na siya sa pagsali ng contests. Dahil seasoned kontesera, nakita ng hurados ang pagiging relaxed niya.

Nagustuhan ng hurados ang dalawang nagtanghal pero isa lang ang aabante sa susunod na round, at ito ay si Jeanel na nakakuha ng markang 91% laban sa 89.3% ni Shekinah.

title: Miss Q&A
description:
Sa pag-ibig, maraming tanong na walang kasagutan. Mapapasabi ka na lang ng, "Hindi ko alam." 'Yan ang hugot ng bandang Spongecola at ni Kai Del Rio sa pagsasanib ang kanilang mga musika't talento.

Sa Miss Q and A, talak ay hindi bitin. Busog sa wit ang mga kandidata for today's video, sina Sashi Giggle Esmeralda, Zha-Zha Divah, at Angel Grey, in their rampa and chukchak na havey.

Si Vice Ganda, namasa ang kili-kili sa daming ganap this Wednesday. From bardagulan to kantahan, parang never-ending ang kulitan. Masarap din balikan ang tamis, pati na ang pait, ng unang pag-ibig. Ang usapang crush at rejection, idaan na lang natin 'yan sa karaoke session! Kapag ba galing sa vacay, talagang unlimited ang energy? Ayun, muntik na namang mag-OT sina Meme!

Sa hinaba-haba ng mga pata-WOW, sa Tumpak Ganern round pa rin ang tuloy. Ang comeback-ing kandidata na si Sashi, bigo na pumaslak muli. Samakatuwid, sina Angel at Zha-Zha ang nagsalpukan sa Wit Lang.

Sobrang init ng panahon. Ang haring araw, talagang umeeksena! Pero mas mainit ang swerte sa Laro Laro Pick game arena. Mula drawing, magkatotoo kaya ang dream 'winning' ng mga Architecture students mula NCR?

"Woke up like this" ang peg ni Kyle in his kulot-kulutan hairdo. Ano nga ba ang goal niya, and in the future, saan niya balak gamitin ang talento? Kinilala nina Vice Ganda ang Dean's Lister at scholar na 'to! Si Charz naman, eksaherada ang 'sikip' ng "Tala" dance moves with backup dancers! Ang lakas ng 'amats' ng mga estudyante, gigil n'yo tuloy si Meme!

After all that fun, si Charz, ang nag-sample ng “Tala” prod, ang umabante sa jackpot round na para bang may swerteng hatid ang ‘masikip’ na dance moves niya. Umabot ng P30,000 ang Li-Pot offer, na sobra pa sa bayarin sa eskwela.

title: Invisible Citizens: Japanese Americans
description: In the first days of World War II, 120,000 Japanese-Americans were taken from their homes and locked in concentration camps for the duration of the war. They lost their homes, their businesses, their friends, and their privileges. For 40 years, the people who were sent away remained silent. "We wanted to show we were 200% American. We never complained, but the scars were deep." INVISIBLE CITIZENS examines the lives of six Japanese-Americans and explores how they have been affected by the internment.

title: Japanese Connection
description: Kung fu sensation Cheung Lik stars as the rough and ready kung fu kid who is tricked into robbing a triad boss. Amongst the things he steals is a contract for opium distribution between the triad boss and the Japanese Yakuza. Now the stage is set for some hate! The triads and the Japs send out all their top fighters to get the list back off the kid before he goes to the police with it. Action pack

title: Fish! A Japanese Obsession

title: Japanese Godfather: Ambition
description: An ambitious Kansai yakuza don moves in on Tokyo using financial and political tactics, sparking conflict with a local criminal association.

title: Memoir of Japanese Assassinations
description: This anthology film consists of nine incidents in the late 19th and early 20th centuries when assassins changed the course of Japanese history.

title: A Japanese Boy Who Draws
description: Shinji is an aspiring manga artist struggling to succeed in his career, and when he accidentally discovers an old drawing by his childhood friend Masaru, a magical journey begins that helps him discover a new inspiration for his art.revenge. The film unfolds a psychological analysis of a social environment characterized by hypocrisy and secrecy, skillfully playing with genre formulas of thrillers and ghost stories.

title: Junji Ito Maniac: Japanese Tales of the Macabre
description: From the mind of horror manga maestro Junji Ito comes a spine-tingling selection of some of his most bizarre, disturbing and terrifying tales.

title: A Japanese Nightingale
description: A young Japanese woman named Yuki runs away and becomes a geisha girl in order to escape marriage to the lecherous Baron Nekko. Her brother's American friend, John Bigelow, falls in love with Yuki and marries her, but Ido, the marriage broker, who will lose a large commission if the wedding of Yuki and the baron is canceled, breaks into the American consulate, murders the consul, and steals the marriage certificate. When Yuki's brother arrives home from America, he is informed that she and John are living together unlawfully. To save her husband from her brother's vengeance, Yuki resolves to marry Baron Nekko, but Ido, having been mistreated by the baron, finally admits his guilt and returns the marriage certificate.

title: The Dragon King's Hot Valet is a runaway mommy
description: Five years ago, herbalist Cecilia slept with fire-poisoned Dragon King Evander and bore a half-dragon cub, Milo. To afford Milo's suppressant, she disguises herself as a man and becomes the king's manservant. Guarding her secret, she turns rival heiress Willow into a best friend. The king falls for his "male servant" and spirals into jealous self-doubt.

title: Love is Sweet
description: It follows the story of a girl named Jiang Jun who meets her close childhood friend, Ma Yuanshuai, in the workplace-this time, however, not as an ally but as a rival - Jiang Jun is an educated woman with a double degree in economics and psychology. Her parents liberal ways of raising her gave rise to her strong, independent, and idealistic character. After graduating from college, she begins to work for a non-profit organization to follow her dream of helping others. However, her father's sudden death leaves her on a crucial crossroad in her life. She decides to join MH, a top investment company, to fulfill her father's dying wish. Jiang Jun runs into her childhood friend Ma Yuanshuai, yet he's different from the gentle and caring protector that she remembered him to be. He is now her rival at work. Furthermore, someone seems to be plotting against her and she must rely on her wits and will to succeed not just in her career, but also in love.

title: RICH GIRL REBORN:GOING CRAZY FOR LOVE
description: Choi Cheong-yeon and Kim Myeong-nam are lovers whose relationship is tested time and again. A crisis at her family’s company and a web of complicated relationships leave Cheong-yeon struggling. Though Myeong-nam remains devoted to her, misunderstandings and sinister schemes drive them apart. Caught in the plots of Park Yong-jun and Choi Hyo-jin, the couple endure countless hardships, with Myeong-nam even suffering a life-threatening injury. Yet their love and trust help them expose the conspiracies and overcome every obstacle. Myeong-nam thwarts Yong-jun’s plans and saves the Choi Group, while Cheong-yeon clears her family’s name. Finally united, they prove that true love can conquer even the greatest challenges.

title: Ane Jiru the animation: Shirakawa san shimai ni omakase - Onêsan ga shite ageru
description: For some reason, Shirakawa Yuu has been living with his grandparents, but he is supposed to live with his mother after an interval of more than ten years with her new husband, that is, his step-father. There, his step-sisters, Shirakawa Kyouko, Ryouko and Anzu, who have grown to be very beautiful women, are waiting for him. The sisters welcome him, and let him use the room of their father who is always absent because of his archaeological studies. In the room, he finds a queer jar. It is a cursed jar that will cast upon him the worst of curses unless he collects women's love juices within a limited period of time.

When she comes to school the next day, the teacher does his duty to get her measurement—albeit in quite an eccentric manner.
